policy.admissibility: fix membership and positive normalized cap weights at signal before future inspection; at least 3 eligible names and all3 quantiles; require observed execution and common-exit quotes and an authenticated same-listing quote-return chain spanning the full XNYS interval
policy.archive_root: G:\4- Institutional Multi-Factor Asset Pricing & Portfolio Analytics Platform
policy.execution: close of next XNYS session after signal; no formation-to-execution return included
policy.exit: close of next monthly execution; reject entire terminal partial cycle
policy.historical_q_mapping: retain ROE alias earnings_yield and all original model IDs; study-specific q-style mapping
policy.inference: original OLS intercept and Bartlett HAC lag3 with finite-sample correction and two-sided t inference; predefined lags0/3/6/12; lag counts retained observations if calendar gaps exist; no significance tuning or FDR-valid claim
policy.interior_gap_policy: a missing interior daily quote is not itself a missing buy-and-hold return: retain only when every consecutive observed return reconciles to its archived quote ratio, these links cover the entire interval, and compounded return matches endpoint ratio; insert no price, daily zero, stale valuation or cash assumption; disclose gaps and make no intraperiod NAV claim
policy.missing_policy: exclude whole quantile with an explicit reason; do not re-rank survivors, reweight survivors, assume cash, stale-price carry, or zero missing return
policy.price_return_label: frozen provider-vintage adjusted-quote returns; dividend-total-return basis not independently established
policy.primary_pricing_sample: per-asset complete-case intersection of all five models; minimum 24 observations and full-rank design for every model; report omitted assets and month gaps
policy.recovery_policy: only original frozen same-vintage, date-effective same-listing observations; verify raw checksum and price-basis identity; any recovered data require explicit parent provenance; no newer downloads
policy.score_policy: reuse authenticated frozen characteristic scores unchanged; independently verify used formation availability and representative source formulas; no factor-definition or numerical-threshold tuning
policy.signal: last XNYS session of each calendar month; frozen score available_at at or before UTC date end
policy.supplementary_pricing_sample: model-specific complete cases; clearly separate from primary common calendar
policy.terminal_policy: no terminal payout without authenticated dated security-specific evidence and explicit cash settlement accounting; otherwise reject group
